# v0.30.4-rc1: a user message kept in the prompt and in the store after compaction (release candidate)

This is the first release candidate for v0.30.4, a patch release on v0.30.2. Its main fix: a compaction pass could drop a user message from the prompt, and a message the host carried only in a hidden `api_content` field was never stored ([#3087](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3087)). This release candidate stores that message and hands the host back its own user rows after a pass that makes no progress.

v0.30.4 also carries the v0.30.3 hotfix for the summary head stored again after a same-length pass ([#3041](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3041)), with the v0.30.3-rc2 rule that keeps a repeated user message in the prompt ([#3061](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3061)), rebuilt for this line. The recall tools now skip a proven copy of the summary head, and `/lcm status` and the doctor warn about two problems that were silent before. It adds one setting, off by default, and no schema change. The [v0.30.2 notes](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/releases/tag/v0.30.2) and the [v0.30.3 notes](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/releases/tag/v0.30.3) still apply, except where this page says otherwise. The smoke stage (L1) bench rows run after this tag (see Qualification).

## Changes since v0.30.2

- **A message the host carried only in a hidden `api_content` field is now stored** ([#3087](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3087), by [#3089](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3089)). Hermes can put a user message only inside another user row's `api_content`, as a complete out-of-band message block, while that row's own text is a different message. Earlier versions stored the row's text and nothing else, so once the host rewrote or compacted the row, the hidden message was gone from the store and from recall. v0.30.4 finds such a block and stores it once as a recall-only row beside the session. A block that carries the host's gateway id is stored once across a row move, a restart, a compaction rewrite and a session rotation; an edited message counts as a new message. The hook context that the host adds to `api_content` on every turn is not stored. The recall-only row never enters the prompt, proactive recall or cleanup; `lcm_grep`, `lcm_recall` and `lcm_expand` find it. If storing it fails, host ingest still succeeds (unless SQLite aborts the whole transaction, for example on a full disk), and `/lcm status` shows a failure count and time.
- **After a compaction pass that makes no progress, LCM-X hands the host back its own user rows unchanged** ([#3087](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3087), by [#3094](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3094)). This is the second half of the fix. On v0.30.2 and v0.30.3, such a pass could return LCM-X's own cached copy of a user row, emptied or shortened, and the host then saved that list. A user message could leave the prompt this way; it stayed in the store, so recall still found it. v0.30.4 returns each of the host's user rows unchanged, content and `api_content` included, at its base position. Together with the change above, this release candidate completes the work on the issue.
- **A same-length compaction pass no longer makes the next ingest store the summary head again** ([#3041](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3041)). This is the v0.30.3 hotfix, carried on this line. A copy already stored stays stored, out of the prompt and out of compaction. The [v0.30.3 notes](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/releases/tag/v0.30.3) describe it in full.
- **A new user message that repeats an earlier one word for word stays in the prompt and in recall** ([#3061](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3061), by [#3086](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3086)). This is the v0.30.3-rc2 rule, rebuilt on this line's head-copy check: a stored row that holds a summary head and then a user message counts as LCM-X's own copy only when that message binds to its own earlier occurrence. When the evidence is missing or ambiguous, the row stays visible. The worst case is a duplicate summary head, never a hidden message.
- **The recall tools skip a proven copy of the summary head** ([#3047](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3047)). `lcm_grep`, `lcm_expand`, `lcm_load_session`, `lcm_recall` and the recall readers now leave out a stored row proven to be LCM-X's own summary head, using the same check as the prompt and compaction. This was a v0.30.3 known issue. Stored rows are unchanged.
- **The head-copy check costs less** ([#3062](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3062), by [#3086](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3086)). The publication write no longer checks rows it then throws away. In the change's timing cell (100,000 rows, and 100 stored rows that each hold a summary head and then a user message), a compaction pass went from 15.1 s to 12.2 s. Some cost remains (see Known issues).
- **The stub-only exit keeps the host's rows and replaces only the stubbed tool outputs** ([#3067](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3067)). Before, a compaction pass that only replaces older tool outputs with short stubs rebuilt the whole list. It could fold the unchanged summary head into the next user row, which rewrote the provider's cached prompt from the start and, after a restart, stored that folded row again. Now the exit returns the host's own list with only the stubbed tool rows changed. A head the host merged with the next user row is still rebuilt, and the exit falls back to the old behaviour when any check fails.
- **After the host refuses a compaction pass, the next pass drops a replayed row only when every row it absorbed is covered by a summary** ([#3052](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3052)). Merged rows that were only partly covered could otherwise be left behind, and compaction could stop until the survival cut ([#3006](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3006)). A reply that no summary covers is never dropped. A failed write of the "refused" mark is retried.
- **`/lcm status` and the doctor warn when the linked SQLite has the WAL-reset bug** ([#3058](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3058), by [#3085](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3085)). With SQLite older than 3.51.3 (apart from the patched 3.50.7+ and 3.44.6+ builds), `/lcm status` shows a `sqlite_wal_reset: warn` line, `/lcm doctor` and the `lcm_doctor` tool show a warning with the upgrade as the recommended action, and the startup log line says what the bug can do. It is a warning, never a failure. An unaffected version leaves every output as before.
- **`/lcm status` and the doctor show compaction passes that free nothing** ([#3081](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3081), by [#3084](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3084)). `/lcm status` shows `hidden_only_streak`, and the doctor warns after three passes in a row that free no host rows. This makes the stall visible; it does not fix it (see Known issues).

## Optional features

- **Turn-start defer gate, `LCM_TURN_START_DEFER_CEILING` (environment variable only), off by default** ([#3084](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3084)). While the context is under the ceiling, an automatic compaction pass in the middle of a tool turn waits for the next turn start. The value is a share of the model window: `0`, the default, turns it off, and any other value must be above 0 and below 1 minus the survival reserve (`LCM_SURVIVAL_RESERVE`, default 0.15). An invalid value is ignored with a config warning. When it is on, LCM-X warns if the ceiling is inert or not tied to the trigger, logs one line per deferral episode, and shows its counters in `/lcm status`. Its rehearsal ran on another build, not on this one: before you turn it on for a live profile, rehearse it on the v0.30.4 build first.

## Known issues

- **Limits of the hidden-message recovery: some forms are still not recovered.** v0.30.4 recovers a message from `api_content` only when it is a complete out-of-band message block. A message carried in any other form is not stored. Three smaller limits of the same change:
  - After a session rotation, `lcm_grep` at its default scope in the new session does not find a recovered message from the old session; `session_scope: all` does.
  - When a row's own text is itself a complete block, a block quoted after it by a host hook is still stored. LCM-X stores it rather than risk losing a real message. A hook-aware boundary is planned for v0.30.5 ([#3091](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3091)).
  - A retry after a busy database at session end can store a recovered block twice when the block has no gateway id. Nothing is lost. A fix is planned for v0.31.0 ([#3092](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3092)).
- **Compaction passes can free no host rows while the walk crosses stored rows the host no longer shows** ([#3081](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3081)). What a user sees: on a long-running store, compaction can run for two to three minutes on about a dozen turns in a row, and the context does not shrink. v0.30.4 shows the stall in `/lcm status` (`hidden_only_streak`) and the doctor. There is no workaround. The fix is now planned for v0.30.5, a patch release after v0.30.4.
- **After a refused compaction pass, a restart or a merged tool row can still leave compaction stuck** ([#3006](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3006), compaction stuck after the host refuses a pass; [#3053](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3053), the "refused" mark not honoured after a cold restart). After the host refuses a compaction pass that stored summaries, a restart before the refusal is recorded can still leave compaction stuck until the survival cut, and a merged row whose tool-calling row has no text still blocks the next pass. Nothing is lost from the store; rows the survival cut removes stay stored and can be recalled. Fix release not yet set.
- **Durable sensitive-pattern redaction (`LCM_SENSITIVE_PATTERNS_ENABLED`) is unsupported: not maintained; do not enable** ([#3096](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3096), docs in [#3097](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3097)). It stays off by default, and a bug that occurs only with it enabled will not be fixed. If you already enabled it, set it to `false`: rows it already redacted stay redacted, and new content is then stored without redaction. The cloud embedding privacy filter is a separate setting and is not affected.
- **With sensitive patterns off, a user row that quotes LCM-X's redaction-marker text can lose a late host annotation on a cache-hit compaction pass** ([#3099](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3099)). When a user row's text quotes LCM-X's literal redaction-marker text, a compaction pass served from LCM-X's cache hands back LCM-X's shorter cached copy of that row, so the host gets the row back without a host annotation added late and without its `api_content`. v0.30.2 behaves the same, and nothing is lost from the store.
- **A store on SQLite older than 3.51.3 can lose whole recent transactions.** With SQLite before 3.51.3, a store in WAL mode with several connections can lose whole recent transactions, through SQLite's own WAL-reset bug ([#1085](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1085); evidence in [#2330](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2330)). This is a storage-layer loss below LCM-X. v0.30.4 now warns about it in `/lcm status` and the doctor, but cannot prevent it: upgrade SQLite. Check your SQLite with `python3 -c "import sqlite3; print(sqlite3.sqlite_version)"`.
- **The head-copy check can still cost a lookup on every turn for a carrier whose message matches an earlier one** ([#3062](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3062)). v0.30.4 reduces this cost but does not remove it: each such row still costs a lookup on every turn while it stays in the prompt window, and a cache for that lookup is planned.
- **The transcript repair for replies lost before v0.30.2 is not in this release** ([#3022](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3022)). Hermes's own transcript still holds those replies. The release for this repair is not yet set.
- **With `LCM_HOST_MESSAGE_UID=off`, the summary head can still be stored again** ([#3060](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3060)). If the host's save stamps the emitted head with a timestamp, a row id and a new uid, the next ingest stores the head again exactly as v0.30.2 does. Nothing is lost. With the setting unset (the default) or `on`, the fix holds. It is not in this release candidate. A fix is planned for v0.31.0.
- **After a restart, a tool call and its stubbed result can be stored a second time when a compaction pass had only stubbed tool outputs** ([#1674](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1674), [#3026](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3026)). Sometimes a pass only replaces older tool outputs with short stubs. If the engine then restarts, the next ingest does not match those stubs to the stored originals, and it stores each call and stub again. Nothing is lost. A context rebuilt from the store can then carry each of those tool calls twice. On the host's compress path no measured case sent a tool call twice in a model request; the duplicates appear only when a context is rebuilt from the store itself. v0.30.4 no longer stores the folded summary head in this case ([#3067](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3067)), but it still stores the tool pairs again. v0.30.2 behaves the same for the tool pairs ([#3073](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3073)). Matching a stub to its stored original after a restart is planned as its own fix.
- **Two kinds of stored head copy still reach the prompt, as on v0.30.2.** Each shows up as a duplicate summary head; no message is lost.
  - A carrier stored before v0.30.0, whose message has no matching host timestamp. Those versions recorded no emission for it, so this release cannot prove it is a copy and keeps it.
  - A copy stored in a child session after a session rotation, when the message it carries has no matching host timestamp and its earlier occurrence is in the parent session. A child-session copy is now recognised and left out when it holds only the summary head, or when its message matches an earlier message with the same host timestamp.
- **In the default uid mode and with `LCM_HOST_MESSAGE_UID=on`, a user message that is an exact paste of the current summary head, with nothing after it, is treated as a copy** ([#3047](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3047)). The row stays stored, but it is left out of the prompt, compaction and recall. This is an accepted tradeoff, pinned by a test. A paste of the summary head followed by another message stays visible ([#3086](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3086)).
- **With `LCM_HOST_MESSAGE_UID=on`, a stub-first exit can return a summary together with the raw rows it covers** ([#3048](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3048)). This is v0.30.2 behaviour. A fix has to keep the rule that only a committing pass changes the rows it returns, so it is planned for v0.31.0, after a design review.
- **Under overflow, one fitted request can leave out rows that no summary covers yet** ([#3064](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3064)). When a request is over the model's window, the survival fit trims it to fit. That one request can omit rows not yet covered by a summary, including a recent user message. The next compaction pass covers them, and nothing is lost from the store. This is v0.30.2 behaviour. A fix is planned for v0.31.0.
- **With `max_assembly_tokens` set below the host's own overhead, a forced-overflow pass can return an empty list** ([#3072](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3072)). It cannot happen at the default settings, which set no such cap, and nothing is deleted from the store. v0.30.2 behaves the same.
- **A crash after a compaction rotation, over ACP on upstream Hermes, can store one user turn twice** ([#2507](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2507)). Fix release not yet set.
- **After a crash during an upgrade from v0.27.0, a composite row is kept beside its replayed parts** ([#1506](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1506)). Fix release not yet set.
- **A tool call and its result can still be stored twice on the first ingest after a restart** ([#3026](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3026)). Nothing is lost; recall can return them twice. LCM-X keeps the copy rather than risk dropping a row.
- **When the host changes a tool result, ingest can store the calling row and an unchanged sibling row a second time, with no restart** ([#2781](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2781)). Nothing is lost; recall can return those rows twice. It was seen with `LCM_HOST_MESSAGE_UID=on` on a running engine. v0.30.2 behaves the same.
- **Older issues that stay open.**
  - A slow first ingest after a host change, with compaction stuck behind it ([#2818](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2818)). Re-timed on v0.30.2: in the test cell the slow first ingest still takes 38 to 40 seconds, over the 30-second bar.
  - Compaction that stops on the same row at every pass ([#1162](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1162)), reported on a v0.30.1 release candidate. There is no workaround yet.
  - A store already stuck behind an old hidden-only leaf stays stuck ([#1141](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1141)), seen on v0.28.1. There is no known way to reach this state at the default settings. There is no in-place repair and no workaround yet.
  - Restart copies ([#1674](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/1674)): at a cold restart, tool results and replies that the host sends without a timestamp can be stored again, one more copy per restart. Nothing is lost. v0.30.4 does not change this, and the fix release is not yet set.

## Upgrade and rollback

- **Upgrade.** No schema change: no new tables, columns or migrations, and the schema version is unchanged. One new kind of data is written into existing tables: a recall-only copy of a message recovered from `api_content`, stored as an ordinary message in a companion session of the same conversation. One new setting, `LCM_TURN_START_DEFER_CEILING`, off by default; leave it off unless you have rehearsed it on this build.
- **Rollback.** Take a SQLite-safe backup first (see `docs/operator-guide.md`). Then install v0.30.2 in place of this build. The store needs no conversion, because this release changes no schema. v0.30.2 has no special handling for the recall-only rows this build stored. It keeps them as ordinary stored user messages in a separate companion session of the same conversation, whose id starts with `lcm-sidecar:`. At the default settings they do not enter the prompt. `lcm_recall`, and `lcm_grep` with `session_scope: all`, can still find them; `lcm_grep` at its default scope does not. If you turned on proactive recall or pre-answer evidence (both off by default), v0.30.2 can bring these rows into the prompt as recall from another session. While you run v0.30.2, a message the host carries only in `api_content` is not stored again, and that version's known issues apply again, including the dropped user message ([#3087](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3087)).

## Qualification

This release changes ingest, compaction and recall on the turn path. The rc1 gates:
- CI on the tag commit: every required check passes. The tag is cut only after a pre-tag check confirms this on that exact commit.
- The R-STABLE no-regression check (rows already handed to the host change only at a compaction commit) runs in that CI and passes.
- The test-impact intersection over this line's diff from the current user release: every mapped suite runs (45 run, 0 skipped). Three families are decided by hand: other instruments, replay and stress harnesses, and historical recorded rows.
- The smoke stage (L1) bench rows run after this tag, and their results go in the v0.30.4 notes. Two checks of the smoke stage are waived for this release candidate only: the session switch while a compaction pass waits for its summary ([#2851](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2851)) and the ordinal planner in a packed session ([#2840](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2840)). The GA runs the full smoke stage.

Per change (synthetic stores, not a real host session; "the base" is the line before that change):
- [#3089](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3089) (store a message carried only in `api_content`): new cells, red on the base and green here, with `LCM_HOST_MESSAGE_UID` unset, `on` and `off`, covering the real host layout, a row move, a rotation, a compaction rewrite, edited and multiple blocks, hook quotes, fault isolation and the busy retry. The uid, out-of-band, ingest-trace and reconcile-trace families match the base, and no golden trace changed.
- [#3094](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3094) (host's user rows after a pass that makes no progress): the restamp cells store 18 rows, as on the base (25 without the fix), and 54 targeted cells pass, with new cells in all three uid modes. It merged as c61d9207 (head cca6ccac) with every CI check passing.
- [#3086](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3086) (repeated user message): the v0.30.3-rc2 cells, 37 failed on the base and 64 passed here. On every test store, the rows treated as copies are a subset of those the base treats as copies: 0 newly hidden rows.
- [#3067](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3067) (stub-only exit): the R-STABLE cells for the stub-only exit, which failed before, all pass.
- [#3084](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3084) (turn-start gate and stall warning): every ported test fails on the base and passes here; with the setting off, the neighbour suites match the base.
- [#3085](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3085) (SQLite warning): version cases 3.46.1 warns; 3.51.3, 3.53.1 and the patched 3.50.7 and 3.44.6 do not.
- Test and CI changes only: CI now runs on this maintenance line and fetches the build its compatibility test needs ([#3037](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3037), [#3038](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3038)); cells that pin two known duplicate-row cases as expected failures ([#3040](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3040), [#3043](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3043)).
- Not proven: these are synthetic stores and test rigs, not a real host session. The turn-start gate has not been rehearsed on this build.
